items.title: Жилые острова · внутри тора
items.description: Крупные жилые острова окружают широкую зелёную зону. Дальняя поверхность с дорожками и зданиями плавно поднимается по внутренней стороне огромного тора. Детализация, количество мелких построек, озеленение и подсветка сокращены по замечанию автора задания.
items.canon_status: Предложение адаптации. Тороидальная геометрия и масштаб не установлены текстом романа.
items.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the attached concept of the ceramic residential islands INSIDE A HUGE TOROIDAL SHIP. The user rejects the excessive small details, repetitive tiny buildings, vegetation clutter and visual noise. Make a dramatically CLEANER, more composed and quieter architectural version of this same space. The transformation must be obvious at first glance.

KEEP: the enormous scale; ivory and very pale celadon faceted rounded ceramic architecture with recessed inhabited windows; a small number of children and unobtrusive care robots; the inhabited landscape curving gently UPWARD toward the far horizon inside the torus; the same slightly elevated oblique wide view and believable high enclosing spacecraft shell. Foreground almost level, distant land rises continuously along the ring. This is the physical ground bending, not merely the roof. Do not flatten the world.

SIMPLIFY THE COMPOSITION to a handful of bold masses and broad calm negative spaces. Show FIVE LARGE distinctive residential islands total in the readable foreground and midground, each with two or three continuous recessed horizontal window bands and broad uninterrupted ceramic surfaces. One large cropped island at left, one long low island at right, two intermediate islands framing a common green, one distant landmark. Buildings feel substantial and inhabited, not tiny identical bungalows. Beyond those, only two or three extremely subtle distant architectural bands dissolve into atmospheric haze. REMOVE the dense carpet of dozens/hundreds of small duplicated buildings up the horizon.

At least 65 percent of the visible ground is CONTINUOUS CLOSE-CUT GREEN LAWN, in two or three very large open shapes. A broad gently S-curved pale concrete pedestrian path connects the islands and continues up the toroidal horizon; only two short branches and ONE restrained elevated connecting bridge. No spaghetti of promenades, many crossings or tiny inset landscape pockets. Retain one small simple circular still fountain as an understated focal point in the common green. Plant only two compact, deliberately grouped groves of low citrus trees at the edges, and sparse low clipped planting. REMOVE the forest of spiky cypress trees, all multicoloured flower borders, busy rooftop jungles, tiny planters, decorative rocks, furniture clutter and foreground foliage blocking the composition. Roof gardens become smooth low green surfaces.

Simplify the spacecraft enclosure to enormous calm pale panels with a few widely spaced structural ribs and ONE soft broad artificial daylight band following the torus. Remove the dense grid of little glowing ceiling squares and thin gold edge strips everywhere. Neutral soft daylight, restrained warm light inside a few windows; lower saturation and microcontrast, matte ceramic and concrete, fresh muted greens, subtle sky-like distance. Approx 12–18 tiny child figures across this enormous scene and two small robots, no adult people, no crowd. The architectural spaces remain visually rich through proportion, volume, shadow, curvature and openness, not ornament or fine detail. High-end cinematic architectural visualization with crisp broad forms and understated texture, not a schematic, not a miniature, not a glossy shopping mall. Landscape 16:9. No text, labels or watermarks. Priority: radically reduce visual noise while preserving the beautiful ceramic island identity, the enormous inhabitable toroidal world and the clearly ascending distant ground.
